name: [❄️] Park a Car🅿️
desc:
🅿️🚗 WELCOME TO PARK-A-CAR! 🗣️

Think you’ve got elite parking skills? Prove it! 😤🔥

HOW TO PLAY:
🚙 Buy a car & take it for a spin
🎯 Park perfectly to unlock it!
💸 Earn cash based on how far you drive
💥 Crash? No worries — retry for a better run!

⏰ REMEMBER: Your cars earn money even while you’re offline! 🚗📈
